source_semantics: Container for applications users connections and configuration; user_id uniqueness guaranteed within tenant
important_relations_or_lifecycle: contains users/apps/connections; scopes identifiers and administration
semantic_risk: Tenant is not IdentityContext

source_semantics: Tenant-local user account/profile associated with apps and authentication connections
important_relations_or_lifecycle: has normalized profile; identities array; metadata; factors/passkeys; history
semantic_risk: Not IdentitySubject; user object can aggregate multiple provider identities

source_semantics: Normalized Auth0-specific profile storing provider-normalized and metadata attributes
important_relations_or_lifecycle: sourced from connection/provider; updated at login or management operations
semantic_risk: Profile data has mixed provenance and is not the subject itself

source_semantics: Auth0 name for user-data/authentication sources including database social and enterprise IdPs
important_relations_or_lifecycle: connection authenticates user; sources profile; enabled for apps/orgs
cm4di_target: C1003 IdentitySource and/or C1010 FederationConnection and/or C1013 ProvisioningConnection
semantic_risk: One vendor term spans multiple neutral semantic roles

source_semantics: Per-provider identity entry in user's identities array
important_relations_or_lifecycle: belongs to provider/connection; multiple entries after account linking
semantic_risk: Not equal to IdentitySubject; not necessarily a full DigitalIdentity instance

source_semantics: Linking two accounts forms primary-secondary relationship and consolidates identities under primary account
important_relations_or_lifecycle: link/unlink lifecycle; primary/secondary asymmetry; requires authenticated/authorized action
semantic_risk: Must not be owl:sameAs; linking does not merge profile attributes from all providers

source_semantics: Tenant-scoped user identifier often provider-qualified
important_relations_or_lifecycle: uniquely identifies Auth0 user within tenant; may vary across tenants
semantic_risk: Identifier scope is tenant/context specific; do not infer global identity

source_semantics: Represents customer/business organization with members roles and enabled connections
important_relations_or_lifecycle: has members; connections; member roles; organization-aware authentication
semantic_risk: Organization ontology should be reused/aligned rather than duplicated

source_semantics: User participates as member of Auth0 Organization
important_relations_or_lifecycle: member assigned roles; authentication can be org-specific
semantic_risk: B2B org membership differs from AccessGroup and social group

source_semantics: Role assigned to organization member for app access
important_relations_or_lifecycle: member receives role; role maps to application authorization
semantic_risk: Not UFO Role

source_semantics: Application registered in tenant and associated with connections/APIs
important_relations_or_lifecycle: enabled connections; authorize flows; client identifier
semantic_risk: Configuration is not software Application entity

source_semantics: Auth0 or custom database user store used for authentication
important_relations_or_lifecycle: creates users; stores/validates credentials; lifecycle scripts
cm4di_target: C1005 IdentityStore; C1003 IdentitySource; C1013 ProvisioningConnection
semantic_risk: Connection adapter not the database itself

source_semantics: SAML/ADFS/LDAP/enterprise IdP connection
important_relations_or_lifecycle: authenticates external enterprise users and maps profile data
semantic_risk: Profile sourcing role may also make provider an IdentitySource

source_semantics: Connection to social identity provider
important_relations_or_lifecycle: delegates authentication; provides provider profile; may participate in account linking
semantic_risk: Social login is federation/authentication, not SemSocialIdentity by itself

source_semantics: Read-only attributes retrieved from upstream authentication provider
important_relations_or_lifecycle: copied/normalized into profile; provenance remains upstream
semantic_risk: Do not treat cached normalized value as independently authoritative

source_semantics: User-editable custom metadata
important_relations_or_lifecycle: stored with profile; not necessarily sourced/verified
semantic_risk: Metadata does not imply verified Claim

source_semantics: Application/administrator-managed metadata often used for access
important_relations_or_lifecycle: stored with profile; can drive authorization
semantic_risk: Metadata values are not automatically Permissions

source_semantics: Passkeys created by user are shown as authentication factors
important_relations_or_lifecycle: enrollment/use/revocation lifecycle
semantic_risk: Authenticator artifact is not Credential in VC sense

source_semantics: Enrolled MFA factor used in authentication
important_relations_or_lifecycle: enroll/challenge/remove lifecycle
semantic_risk: Factor term may cover heterogeneous mechanisms

source_semantics: Authorization on a device links device to user account and refresh token
important_relations_or_lifecycle: link/unlink; refresh token revocation
semantic_risk: Device association does not mean device is IdentitySubject of the user's DigitalIdentity

source_semantics: Token used to obtain new tokens and associated with session/device contexts
important_relations_or_lifecycle: issue/rotate/revoke/expire; stored in session semantics
cm4di_target: CM4DI-C3013 TemporaryCredential or credential-token profile mapping
semantic_risk: Refresh token is not Session itself

source_semantics: Administrative status restricting user access
important_relations_or_lifecycle: block/unblock lifecycle
semantic_risk: Current CM4DI lacks generic AccountStatus mode
